POWER MECHANICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project.

5. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.

6. When learning Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

7. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

9. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.

10. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

11. When learning Steering system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Steering system.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Steering system.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Steering system.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Steering system.

12. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.

13. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.

14. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.

15. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.

16. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Limits, fits and tolerance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain ISO Thread forms and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Braking system and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Suspension system and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Steering system and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Soldering in Vehicle systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Engine systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Four-stroke petrol engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
